segments.contextAfter: `style`: The style characteristics to apply to the button. Use this value to apply default appearance characteristics to the button. These characteristics visually communicate, such as by color, information about what the button does. For example, specify a style of [`NSTableViewRowAction.Style.destructive`](nstableviewrowaction/style-swift.enum/destructive.md) to indicate an action is destructive to the underlying data. For a list of possible style values, see [`NSTableViewRowAction.Style`](nstableviewrowaction/style-swift.enum.md).

segments.contextAfter: `handler`: The block to execute when the user clicks the button associated with this action. AppKit makes a copy of the block you provide. When the user selects the action represented by this object, AppKit executes your `handler` block on the app’s main thread. This parameter must not be `nil`. This block has no return value and takes the following parameters: - **action**: The action object representing the action that the user selected.
